title: Channel Islands
html:
Channel Islands is a North American map added to OpenFront in Update 34.0 by crunchybbb — the Southern California coast from Los Angeles down to San Diego, with the Channel Islands scattered offshore.

Nations

The map features 44 named nations, including Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Laguna Beach, San Clemente, San Juan Capistrano and Santa Catalina.
